notes: Fresh-volume pg_basebackup restored into an independent instance with identical object, link, migration and index-plan state, and a physical streaming standby promoted after source termination with the committed probe preserved at the same LSN. The gate names zero committed-record loss and states no scale; this ran at 100000 objects and 500000 links producing a 442138118 byte volume. Prior art for this gate was measured at 10,000,000 objects and a 36.59 GB basebackup, so this satisfies the threshold as written but is not evidence about restore behaviour at that size. Scale belongs to the ontology_scale gate; if durability should carry a scale floor of its own that is a threshold change and needs recording as one.
